_about: Public-domain Washington Gladden (1836-1918, Columbus Congregationalist, father of the Social Gospel) for the Word Hoard: Working People and their Employers (1876), Applied Christianity (1887), Who Wrote the Bible? (1891), Ruling Ideas of the Present Age (1895), Seven Puzzling Bible Books (1897), The Christian Pastor (1898), How Much Is Left of the Old Doctrines? (1899), Social Salvation (1902), The Church and Modern Life (1908), Recollections (1909) and Present Day Theology (1913), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
